room_rent.note: Room rent limit is specified in the Policy Schedule per plan (Secure Basic, Elite, Supreme, Complete). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; specific limit per plan stated in schedule, not detailed in wording text.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on all claims at non-network hospitals; 10% co-pay on all claims for insured above 60 years regardless of network.

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract, CABG, knee/hip replacement, PTCA, hysterectomy, hernia, piles, etc.
sub_limits.note: Extensive disease/procedure sub-limits vary by plan (Secure Basic to Secure Complete). Optional 'Waiver of Sub-limits' add-on available.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in base policy. Hospital Daily Cash has a 48-hour deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months or 24 months depending on plan chosen as per schedule. Base/default is 36 months.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most listed conditions (cataract, hernia, piles, etc.) have 24-month wait; obesity surgery and some others have 36-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). No optional maternity add-on mentioned in this wording.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (10% or 25%/yr depending on plan)
cumulative_bonus.note: Base plan: 10%/yr up to 50% or 25%/yr up to 100% depending on plan. Optional Enhanced CB add-on can go up to 150%.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured is an optional cover; triggers after original SI + CB exhausted; available for in-patient claims only; unused reload lapses at year end.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation period and limit specified in Policy Schedule; exact days not stated in wording text.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation period and limit specified in Policy Schedule; exact days not stated in wording text.

day_care.note: Coverage limited to procedures on the company's listed day-care procedure list (400+ procedures listed in annexure).

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ayush.display: Covered up to basic SI (inpatient only)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to basic Sum Insured; OPD, day care, pre/post-hosp AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Emergency local road ambulance covered; maximum liability as specified in schedule (amount not stated in wording).

modern_treatments.note: Modern/robotic treatments not explicitly mentioned as a separate benefit or exclusion in this wording.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure-A standard exclusion lists.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; treatment outside India is a specific exclusion.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), claims cannot be contested except for fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly premium mode. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year.

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with credit transfer for PED, waiting periods, moratorium, and no-claim bonus.

notable_exclusions: STDs/HIV, dental (unless accident-related), OPD treatment, treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, prosthetics/external devices, RMO/surcharges
optional_riders: Reload of Sum Insured, Enhanced Cumulative Bonus (up to 150%), Waiver of Medical Expense Sub-limits
